claim.purpose: Repair C-SDLC v2 claim authority recovery around unrelated terminal drift, stale inactive projections, and stale dormant design inputs.

initial.title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2] Make claim recovery independent of unrelated terminal drift and stale design inputs
initial.goal: Keep claim authority scans precise and recoverable when unrelated terminal records, inactive stale projections, or dormant design inputs are stale.
initial.required_outcome: Non-overlapping init, bind, and reacquire ignore unrelated stale terminal identities and inactive stale projections; dormant claim authority can be reacquired before typed design reapproval; live overlaps still fail closed.
authority_boundary: C-SDLC v2 lifecycle authority remains in the Rust binaries and typed state store.
The patch changes claim-scan filtering, terminal-check ordering, and authority-record replacement only; it does not weaken live claim collision, checkout, lease, or CAS checks.
operator_constraints: never touch or switch primary main
initial.task_boundary: Record and publish the product/test patch for issue #5737 from the existing worktree.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Unrelated stale terminal identity cannot block non-overlapping init, bind, or reacquire.
AC-2: A dormant issue with changed design inputs can reacquire authority and then use typed design reapproval.
AC-3: Real overlapping live claims still fail closed.
AC-4: Stale projections whose claim branch/worktree do not match their active checkout do not act as collision authority.
AC-5: Focused Gate 2 tests and strict Clippy pass.
dependencies: existing C-SDLC v2 claim and store APIs
repo-native v2 binaries from adl-wp-5107 target/debug
initial.plan_summary: Initialize and bind #5737 lifecycle state, validate the focused Gate 2 patch and strict Clippy, record exact-head review, then publish a ready PR.

steps.action: Initialize and bind issue-local C-SDLC v2 lifecycle state for #5737.
Run focused Gate 2 regression proof and strict Clippy.
Record exact-head review, commit, push, and publish a ready PR.

invariants: non-overlap scans do not consult unrelated terminal receipt identity
inactive stale projections do not reserve protected paths
overlapping live claims still fail closed
rendered cards are generated by typed v2 tooling
risks: an active worktree may expose a real protected-path collision
strict Clippy may surface warnings in the touched crate
stop_conditions: protected-path collision is reported by typed v2 binding
exact-head review has actionable in-scope findings

validation_lanes.proof_role: Focused Gate 2 regression for unrelated stale terminal identity, stale projection filtering, reacquire, and live overlap behavior.
Strict Clippy over the C-SDLC v2 crate for the touched lifecycle/store/test surface.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on stale CAS, protected-path collision, missing lifecycle evidence, failed focused tests, failed Clippy, or stale exact-head review.
review_prompts: Check that terminal receipt identity is only consulted after a protected-path overlap is detected.
Check that stale projections whose claim branch/worktree do not match their active checkout are ignored for collision authority.
Check that authority-only reacquisition preserves card identity and does not bypass typed design reapproval.
Check that live overlapping claims still fail closed and tests cover the regression without weakening safety.
